args.title: Invalidate existing bearer tokens on password reset
args.body:
File: src/api/auth.ts

Bearer tokens are stateless JWTs verified only by signature and expiry in requireAuth; a password reset (password-reset/confirm) never invalidates tokens issued before it, so a captured token keeps working until it naturally expires. Fix by recording a passwordChangedAt/tokenVersion on the user, embedding it in issued tokens, and rejecting tokens in requireAuth whose value predates the user's current one; bump it whenever setPassword is called.

This comment was written by RepoMind, an automated triage agent. To reach a person, mention @ledgerline/maintainers.

requireAuth only checks a JWT's signature and expiry (src/api/auth.ts), and password-reset/confirm never invalidates tokens issued earlier, so a captured bearer token stays valid until it expires on its own even after a password reset. Opened a draft PR proposing a passwordChangedAt/tokenVersion check in requireAuth, bumped on password reset.
